√dhvaṅs 'scatter'
present: [1.] dvaṅsati dvaṅsate etc. B.+ 
perfect: dadhvaṅsus dadhvaṅsire dadhvasé 
aorist: [2.] dhvasán -- [3.] adadhvaṅsat -- [5.] adhvaṅsiṣṭa 
[future: dhvaṅsiṣyate dhvaṅsitā ]
verbal: dhvasta B.+ -dhvasya E.+ 
secondary: passive: dhvasyate dhvasyati -- intensive: danīdhvaṅs- -- desiderative: didhvaṅsiṣa- -- causative: dhvaṅsáyati etc. B.+ dhvaṅsáyate etc. dhvasáyati etc. 
derivatives: -dhvasa E.+ dhvasán (n.) ŚB. dhvasáni V. dhvasánti (n.) RV. dhvasirá RV. dhvasti C. dhvasmán RV. dhvasrá RV.B. dhvaṅsá AV.+ -dhvaṅsaka C. dhvaṅsin E.+ dhváṅsana B.+ dhvaṅsi S.

√dhvan 'sound'
present: [1.] dhvanati etc. 
perfect: dadhvanus 
aorist: [3.] adidhvanat adadhvanat -- [5.] ádhvanīt 
[future: dhvaniṣyati dhvanitā ]
verbal: dhvanita dhvāntá B.+ 
secondary: intensive: dandhvan- -- causative: dhvanayati dhvanayīt adhvānayat dhvānita 
derivatives: dhvana dhvanyà RV. dhvaní AV.C. dhvanana S.+ dhvāna S.+ dhúni? V.B. dandhvana E. 
The RV. forms are set off by BR., perhaps rightly, to a separate √dhvan 'cover', to which then dhvāntá RV.E.+ 'dark' is also referred.
